$comment: S25 NASA FIRMS active fires (T076). Measure columns added to the common envelope (common.json). Field map: configs/sources/s25.yaml. Fetched with the owner's MAP_KEY (H09, D176); recorded URLs keep the literal MAP_KEY segment.

fields.name: detection_id
fields.meaning: SHA256 of satellite, UTC acquisition minute and position to 5 decimals; no ID is published

fields.name: confidence
fields.meaning: low, nominal or high (CSV l, n, h)

fields.name: sensor
fields.meaning: satellite code: N, N20 or N21

fields.name: latency_minutes
fields.meaning: fetch time minus acquisition time, minutes

clip: detections whose pixel centre lies in the state polygon; repeats of the same detection are dropped
not_included: no confirmed-fire or structure-fire label: a hotspot is a satellite thermal anomaly
